# Peridot Dental Care

> Peridot Dental Care is a comprehensive dental clinic in Woodbridge, Ontario, offering preventative, restorative, surgical, pediatric, and cosmetic dental services led by Dr. Faghih Nasiri and Dr. Sabetahd.

Located in Woodbridge, Peridot Dental Care provides a full spectrum of dental treatments from routine cleanings and oral hygiene to advanced procedures like dental implants, oral surgery, and cosmetic dentistry. The practice utilizes modern diagnostic technology including digital X-rays and intraoral scanners to deliver patient-centered care.
